evals.prompt: I just fixed the bug where the search page returned 502 while the API container was booting. Document it.
evals.expected_output: A bug-fixed document in the right folder for the estate's shape, with the required sections, the in-plain-terms analogy when the cause crossed a boundary, and the index row.
expectations: Reads the estate's shape off the disk before choosing docs/bug-fixed/ or docs/bug-fixed/REPO/
Names the file after the failure, not a ticket
Includes pasted evidence and a verify command plus a check that the fix is not merely masked
Moves the matching unresolved document if one existed, rather than leaving a copy
Keeps any docs/ path out of code comments and the commit message

evals.prompt: Write up why checkout sometimes charges twice; we haven't fixed it yet.
evals.expected_output: An unresolved document with a resolution tracker, options grouped by role, a companion one-pager and task cards at the bottom.
expectations: Files it under docs/unresolved/TOPIC/ with a broad topic
Numbers solution options to match the tracker rows and groups them by the role that would make the change
Ends the document with generated task cards, one per tracker row, with no After on open cards
Builds the same-basename HTML one-pager and rebuilds the doc assistant with a clean --check
